key_insight: CE-Agent combines evidence-based risk constraints with CT findings to predict cardiovascular and lung cancer risk while quantifying uncertainty from missing inputs.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support joint cardiopulmonary risk assessment from a lung-screening visit and flag uncertain cases for further review.
method: Constrains risk-factor weights using published epidemiological evidence before fitting patient outcomes.
Learns local baseline risk and added CT phenotype contributions from cohort data.
Uses closed-form uncertainty propagation to estimate risk intervals when inputs are missing.
evidence_signal: Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, the abstract reports improved cardiovascular prediction, external-site generalization, and lung cancer performance matching established screening models.
watch_item: Prospective evaluation is needed to establish whether uncertainty-guided review and imaging improve patient outcomes in routine care.
paper_title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
